svg.title: How many agents real swarms have
svg.desc: 99 of 153 works state how many agents work at once; the median is 7. ≥10: 42; ≥100: 15; ≥1,000: 7; ≥10,000: 4.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
